notes.title: Historic Football
notes.notes:
We just added a new football map that allows you to play in a colosseum sitting on the kitchen table within the map. Is it a toy ? Is it a model for a school project ?  The flies don't care, they are using it for their own fun and games. Enjoy!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33368073/e5cde18953ca5fdbe2275cea8b706e1a85735fe8.png[/img]

notes.title: GOOOAAALLL!!
notes.notes:
NEW GAME MODE

We are happy to announce the arrival of Flyball ! This new mode allows you to compete with your friends in a heated battle of football in a whole new way. 2 hoops suspended from the ceiling allows you to score extra points with style and show off your skills and if your low on stamina you'll find a powerup dead center to give you the extra boost you need to mark your goal.


Have fun and bring friends along for the party!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33368073/0a87736961b1519baa12098dc195f6a5fd31aaa0.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33368073/c5776db0036dde935631159611086ca01c31f7a3.png[/img]

notes.title: New Update
notes.notes: Now it is even easier to get unstuck if you have the misfortune of clinging to a wall or being belly up on the floor, camera will now zoom in to allow you to have a better view point to fly away.
